payload.text:
NEWSROOM BRIEF

Tesla's cash rebound rests on more than lower spending

Tesla's cash rebound had two drivers: higher operating inflow and lower capital outlays.

What to watch: The stronger case for durability would be operating cash that continues to cover investment as liability obligations are met, together with a sustained improvement in operating margins.

Full brief: https://capitalchronicle.substack.com/p/pending-publication-54786100c3d59d8c
